Gabe CS: FYI Solaris Retail's recommender squad flipped a nightly bulk rerank; embedding writes spiked ~5-7x at 02:10 PT and their API tail latency climbed. Upsell signal but also renewal risk.
Rina CSE: confirmed in traces. They expanded context from 4k->9k; KV cache eviction visible.
Gabe CS: onboarding: completed basics but not performance deep-dive. Omar, renewal is Sept 6 — we should surface dedicated option.
Omar AM: noted. Can we get a short triage and a ballpark cost to propose a pilot?
Lee SRE: I can provision a 2x test slice for soak testing, ~1hr. Will run synthetic rerank load.
Rina CSE: quick mitigations: enable per-customer KV namespace, raise prefix TTL, consider 8-bit quant variant for throughput.
load-bot: alert: solaris-prod embeddings queue > 180 for 8m; oncall paged. <https://console.redwood.ai/alerts/REDACTED>
Gabe CS: customer feedback: "accuracy improved but occasional incomplete responses under load". Filing ENG-6120.
Omar AM: action list: Rina to deliver perf runbook + config snippet; Lee to provide test slice results; Gabe to draft upsell brief. Due EOD.
Rina CSE: snippet:
POST /v1/customers/solaris/config 
{ "kv_namespace": "solaris-v1", "prefix_ttl": 3600, "use_quantized": true }
Lee SRE: test slice up 10.50.6.21, running load now.
Gabe CS: thanks all — will update Solaris and add CRM flag for expansion.
